newsitem.title: UK: Ecuador officials leave London ahead of roadshow.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador officials leave London ahead of roadshow.

text.p: Two senior Ecuadorian officials had to leave London ahead of an investor presentation on investing in the country, organisers of the conference told Reuters on Tuesday.
"Minister of Finance Carlos Davalos and central bank general manager (governor) Fidel Jaramillo had to fly back to Ecuador," a spokesman at Canning House said, but he could give no other details.
The two men were to address potential investors at a conference in London.
The conference will go ahead without them, with minister of energy and mining Raul Baca and president of the monetary board Danilo Carrera among others expected to address the conference.
The delegation from Ecuador has visited New York, and are meant to go on to Madrid from London.
Sources involved in the conference said it was believed the two key officials had to return as Ecuador's government will announce a package of new economic policies on Monday.
